items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Ding' in the context of the interviewee helping a singer, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship or specific interaction with Ding, only acknowledging the general situation.

ctx.x: And I remember the piano player, and it was probably you trying to help her find her note and it was like Ding [sings].
